title: cards
description: Sports card database: card search, full set checklists, parallel lookup, card identification.
summary: Sports card database: card search, full set checklists, parallel lookup, card identification.
offersHint: Sports card database: card search, full set checklists, parallel lookup, card identification. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://mycardfolio.com/api/mcp

toolsPreview.name: search_cards
toolsPreview.description: Full-text search over the MyCardfolio sports card database. Searches player/subject names, card numbers, products, sets, and card details. Optionally filter by sport and year.

toolsPreview.name: get_card
toolsPreview.description: Full detail for a single card by its card_id, plus a few related cards from the same set.

toolsPreview.name: get_set_checklist
toolsPreview.description: Complete checklist of cards in a set by set_id, with set metadata. Output is capped at 500 cards.

toolsPreview.name: browse
toolsPreview.description: Navigate the database hierarchy: no arguments lists sports with card counts; sport lists years; sport + year lists products; product_id lists sets.

toolsPreview.name: find_variants
toolsPreview.description: Find parallels/variants of a card: cards sharing the same year, product, card number, and subjects but belonging to a different set (e.g. base vs. refractor).

toolsPreview.name: identify_card
toolsPreview.description: Parse a free-text card description or eBay-style listing title (e.g. "1989 Upper Deck Ken Griffey Jr #1 PSA 10") and return the best database matches with a confidence note.

toolsPreview.name: card_of_the_day
toolsPreview.description: MyCardfolio's featured card of the day (changes daily).
